reviews.title: Can be great, but developers money hungry
reviews.text: I’ve been on preply for many years, but the greed is insane.  I’m a student and it usually works, but unfortunately my biggest issue is when you buy a lot of lessons and the tutor sucks.  You can’t get your money back on future lessons unless you fight with customer support.  My other biggest issue is when tutors need to cancel on us students.  Tutors have the right to reschedule your class to a new time without your consent.  If you don’t attend this new class time, the student has to pay.  For example, many of my classes have been rescheduled or simply scheduled while I’m asleep.  How can I attend class whilst I’m sleeping?  How did I even know my class was rescheduled when I’m asleep?  Or at work?  So the issue is that it’s not up to the student to cancel and pay for the class.  This has already happened to me several times.  In order to get your money back, you have to fight with customer support.  I’m not investing hundreds of dollars in tutoring to be stressed out about my money.  I shouldn’t have to pay for classes when my tutors reschedule me without my consent.  The other issue is, if I invested in a tutor, I should be able to get my money back with no issue, especially if the tutor was mean and condescending.  I have also recommended this app to my friends.  One of them got into an accident and wasn’t able to take  her classes.  She was billed $600 dollars and she was never able to get the money back or take classes.  The money disappears and the tutors don’t see the money either.  Please put your students first and stop taking our money.  Tutors should not be able to schedule our classes without permission.  I have already spoken to your team too many times on this matter.

reviews.title: Love it, but could be better
reviews.text: I really like this app for language tutoring. Personally, I really like my tutor, I hit it off with the first one I met with which was amazing. However, I really don’t like the subscription model and my first tutor I was recommended didn’t speak English (I didn’t meet with her). For the subscription, I just don’t think it fits for what this app is doing. It’s like a forced subscription model into a platform that doesn’t really work for that. It would be nice if they kept the subscription model while also leaving the option for people to not have a subscription and still book their tutor. For the first recommended tutor I got, the app recommended an amazing tutor. However, she didn’t speak English, she spoke French and Italian, I’m a B1 French speaker so I would’ve been fine since I only speak French with my current tutor, but it was an odd recommendation given that I don’t speak Italian. From a learning perspective, I think it can be helpful to be put in the deep end, but in general I think the highlighted recommended tutor should speak your native language.

reviews.title: subscription based—SAVE YOUR MONEY FOR ELSEWHERE.
reviews.text: While the tutors are affordable and talented, the app is based off of a subscription. You have to subscribe to a tutor to have lessons. If you have too many lessons, they expire within 28 days, or you have to use this complex workaround system where you are constantly scheduling, cancelling, and rescheduling your lessons for later dates so that you don’t waste your money. This is very unfortunate for you, and for your tutor, as it makes their schedule more variable and complex and breaks trust. SAVE YOUR MONEY. Find something else that is affordable, easier, and more relational.
